question: Among blue-haired male superheroes who have more than 10 superpowers, how many also possess a strength attribute value of exactly 100?

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT s."XCL_018"
  FROM superhero AS s
  INNER JOIN colour AS c_hair ON s."XCL_023" = c_hair."XCL_005"
  INNER JOIN gender AS g ON s."XCL_021" = g."XCL_007"
  WHERE c_hair."XCL_006" = 'Blue'
    AND g."XCL_008" = 'Male'
    AND s."XCL_018" IN (
      SELECT hp."XCL_012"
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      GROUP BY hp."XCL_012"
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hp."XCL_013") > 10
    )
    AND s."XCL_018" IN (
      SELECT ha."XCL_009"
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha
      INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003"
      WHERE a."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
        AND ha."XCL_011" = 100
    )
) AS qualifying_heroes
